title: CAE: Repurposing the Critic as an Explorer in Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper introduces CAE (Critic as an Explorer), a lightweight algorithm that repurposes value networks in deep reinforcement learning for exploration without adding extra parameters. The method leverages embeddings from existing value networks combined with multi-armed bandit techniques to generate exploration bonuses, achieving provable sub-linear regret bounds while requiring only ~10 lines of code to implement. Experiments on MuJoCo and MiniHack demonstrate that CAE and its extension CAE+ (which adds a small auxiliary network with <1% parameter increase) outperform state-of-the-art exploration methods, effectively bridging theoretical rigor with practical efficiency.
